entities.name: Maladola
entities.description: Orzhov angel on Ravnica, chief warrior-executioner of the Orzhov Syndicate and a member of its ruling Triumvirate.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild ruled by a Triumvirate after the Obzedat's assassination.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild Maladola defected from long ago.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who assassinated the Obzedat ghost council and tried to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: Orzhov ghost council assassinated by Kaya.

entities.name: Triumvirate
entities.description: Group holding power in the Orzhov after the Obzedat's fall.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker whose Eternals attacked Ravnica.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle on Ravnica against Nicol Bolas and his Eternals.

entities.name: Parhelion II
entities.description: Boros airship from which Maladola joined the battle.

events.summary: Kaya tries to rally the Orzhov against Bolas but meets resistance from the Triumvirate.
events.quote: Kaya tried to rally the Orzhov to fight Nicol Bolas and his Eternals

events.summary: Maladola falls in line with the other Triumvirate members, offering only a token honor guard.
events.quote: she ultimately fell in line with the other Triumvirate members

events.summary: Maladola joins the battle from the Boros airship Parhelion II, leading squadrons of angels.
events.quote: she joined the battle from the Boros airship Parhelion II
